javax.swing.event

接口 TableColumnModelListener

  • 所有超级接口:
    EventListener
    所有已知实现类:
    JTable, JTable.AccessibleJTable, JTableHeader, XMBeanAttributes, XMBeanNotifications, XTable

    public interface TableColumnModelListener
extends EventListener
    TableColumnModelListener defines the interface for an object that listens to changes in a TableColumnModel.
    作者:
    Alan Chung
    另请参阅:
    TableColumnModelEvent

      void columnAdded(TableColumnModelEvent e)
      Tells listeners that a column was added to the model.
      void columnMarginChanged(ChangeEvent e)
      Tells listeners that a column was moved due to a margin change.
      void columnMoved(TableColumnModelEvent e)
      Tells listeners that a column was repositioned.
      void columnRemoved(TableColumnModelEvent e)
      Tells listeners that a column was removed from the model.
      void columnSelectionChanged(ListSelectionEvent e)
      Tells listeners that the selection model of the TableColumnModel changed.
